source_agency: City of Austin Development Services Department

permits.agency: City of Austin Development Services Department

agencies: City of Austin Development Services Department

explanations.trigger_explanation: If a project in the City of Austin extraterritorial jurisdiction requires subdivision platting, the City of Austin subdivision application process commonly applies.

known_unknowns: Many linear utility projects do not require platting unless they create or reconfigure lots, public easements, or subdivision improvements.
advisories: Additional review recommended before assigning this rule because ETJ jurisdiction and platting need depend on the land transaction and subdivision structure, not just the utility work itself.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the City of Austin clearly publishes ETJ subdivision procedures, but applicability to utility corridors is project-structure dependent.
